status_summary: Neither named step was found: no White House Special Assistant for recruiting and retention and no suspension of MHS Genesis at Military Entrance Processing Stations. Related DOD actions exist: a Secretary of Defense memo of 2025-04-24 ordered a review of medical conditions that disqualify applicants and of waiver rules, and a memo of 2025-06-13 set up a 12-month Recruitment Task Force, co-chaired by the chief Pentagon spokesman and the official performing the duties of the Under Secretary for Personnel and Readiness, that aims in part to reduce the waiver backlog and unify recruiting technology. ClearanceJobs reported in late July 2025 that newly signed guidance makes some conditions, such as congestive heart failure, ineligible for waiver, and DOD News reported on 2025-07-02 that the Army had reached its goal of 61,000 recruits four months early.

timeline.event: Secretary of Defense memo orders a review of medical conditions that disqualify people from enlistment and of the waiver rules.
